dataset.name: MaleCNS v1.0 mechanosensory / proprioceptive sensory inventory
dataset.note: Extends assets/male_cns_v1_neural_io.json with the sense organs that report body state. Same group schema and selector style. Every count, root_id and cell type is measured from the annotation table. Groups overlap by design: body_tactile contains leg_tactile and notum_tactile, and ascending_proprioceptive contains the ascending subsets.
